title: Hans Ehlers Farm, Corncrib, F Street, Papillon 18 Damsite, Millard, Douglas County, NE
notes: Significance: Located northwest of the farmstead, this is a one-story, rectangular wood-frame structure with a gabled roof oriented on a north-south axis.  The shed is clad with angular open slats on the east and west sides and clad on the north and south side with shiplap siding.  The building contains double sliding doors.
Unprocessed Field note material exists for this structure: FN-40
